user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 401 lux
期望 温度 处于 26 ℃ 到 28 ℃
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() < 401 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() > 401 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() > 28 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_cooling_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() < 26 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor.is_person_present() == true THEN switch_heating_mode() NWT_Internet_Mobile_Air_Conditioner
